advisories.summary: is_local_url() misclassifies remote URLs as trusted local origins. Any URL beginning with http://app. passes the check, including http://app.evil.com/.

exemptions.description: Windows and Android only. macOS and Linux are not affected.
exemptions.verify: If you do not ship for Windows or Android, this does not apply.

exemptions.description: Only applications that register a custom URI scheme via register_uri_scheme_protocol are affected.
exemptions.verify: Search your Rust sources for register_uri_scheme_protocol. If it does not appear, this does not apply.

advisories.summary: The shell plugin's open endpoint does not validate its argument against the configured scope, allowing arbitrary command execution.

severitySources.label: High
severitySources.note: primary source for this rule's severity

exemptions.description: Not affected if open is explicitly set to true, or if a validation regex is configured for it.
exemptions.verify: Check the shell plugin configuration: an explicit "open": true, or a regex such as "tauri^" that matches nothing, means this advisory does not apply.

advisories.deprecationNote: shell open was deprecated in 2.1.0 (#[deprecated(since = "2.1.0", note = "Use tauri-plugin-opener instead.")]). Migrating to tauri-plugin-opener is the recommended fix.

advisories.summary: Origin checks can be bypassed from an iframe, exposing the IPC bridge to untrusted frames.

exemptions.description: Requires script execution inside a script-enabled iframe, e.g. via XSS.
exemptions.verify: If your app never renders untrusted content in an iframe with scripts enabled, exploitation is not possible.

advisories.summary: The updater private key could be embedded in frontend bundles when a Vite envPrefix includes TAURI_.

severitySources.label: Low
severitySources.note: primary source for this rule's severity; the three published gradings disagree
NIST; NVD explicitly flags a scoring discrepancy with the CNA

exemptions.description: Frameworks other than Vite are not affected.
exemptions.verify: If the project does not build with Vite, this advisory does not apply.

exemptions.description: An envPrefix of only ['VITE_'] is not affected.
exemptions.verify: Check envPrefix in vite.config.*; if it does not include 'TAURI_', this advisory does not apply.

exemptions.description: Default production builds do not embed the key. Leakage requires a debug build in which the frontend references the variable directly.
exemptions.verify: Confirm against the real bundle: grep -r "TAURI_PRIVATE_KEY" dist/

advisories.summary: A regression let the filesystem scope check pass for dotfiles that should have been denied.

exemptions.description: Only affects fs endpoints configured with a wildcard scope.
exemptions.verify: Check whether your fs allowlist scope contains a wildcard. Without one, this does not apply.
If you ship only for Windows, this does not apply.

advisories.summary: An open redirect can expose the IPC bridge to an attacker-chosen origin.

exemptions.description: Only affects applications that implement redirection to arbitrary URLs.
exemptions.verify: If your app never navigates to a URL derived from untrusted input, this does not apply. Workaround: restrict redirect inputs.

advisories.summary: Overly permissive filesystem glob scopes could expose dotfiles.

severitySources.note: GHSA publishes a vector without a numeric score for this advisory

exemptions.description: Only scopes containing a wildcard (*, ?, [...]) are affected. A ** scope is not.
exemptions.verify: Check your fs scope entries for single-wildcard patterns.

advisories.summary: The filesystem scope could be partially bypassed.

exemptions.description: Only affects flows using glob characters via file dialogs or drag-and-drop.
exemptions.verify: If your app does not accept paths from a file dialog or drag-and-drop, this does not apply.

advisories.summary: readDir could follow symbolic links out of the permitted scope. The published affected range is imprecise upstream (stated as the 1.0.x line up to 1.0.6); the range below reflects that imprecision.

severitySources.label: Low
severitySources.note: no CVSS score published for this advisory

exemptions.description: Only affects applications with the readDir endpoint enabled.
exemptions.verify: Check whether readDir is enabled in your fs allowlist.
